## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

`test_block_fp4.py::test_workspace_layout_is_byte_identical_without_fp4` compares `dataclasses.asdict(layout)` against a frozen snapshot. ce0710d78 ("the e4m3 KV cache") appended five fields to the workspace layout: `kc8`, `vc8`, `kv_inv`, `kv_gathered` and `kv_len_t`. Each is `-1` unless `kv_cache_dtype` is e4m3. The snapshot was not updated, so the dicts differ only by those keys. This PR adds the five keys as `-1` to `_COMMON`. Every snapshotted offset stays the same, which is the invariant the test exists to freeze.

## Why

All 12 parametrizations fail on every `python/*/cutedsl` lane of develop schedule pipeline 74082381 (FE commit 149f1150d), e.g. job 489328317 (cutlass-4.7:sm80):

```
Left contains 5 more items:
{'kc8': -1, 'kv_gathered': -1, 'kv_inv': -1, 'kv_len_t': -1, 'vc8': -1}
```

The previous schedule (73793365, ae1c4d52a) did not have ce0710d78 and did not show this failure.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test-only.

## Testing

Run against this branch's `python/cudnn` (overlay over the built extension; `cudnn.__file__` checked):

- `pytest gated_attention_block/cutedsl/test_block_fp4.py -k workspace_layout_is_byte_identical`
  - With this change: 12 passed.
  - With the unmodified `HEAD` copy of the test: 12 failed, with the same diff as CI.
- `pre-commit run`: clean.

---
